title: SYNTHESIS AND BIOLOGICAL SCREENING OF ANALOGS OF ARYL TETRALONE
author: Chaitramallu M1, Devaraju Kesagodu1, Dakshayini Chandrashekarachar2
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Grignard coupling to make trimethoxy phenyl naphthol
steps.instruction: React the substituted tetralone with 3,4,5‑trimethoxy‑1‑bromobenzene in the presence of magnesium metal using dry tetrahydrofuran (THF) to obtain trimethoxy phenyl naphthol (compounds 2a‑f).

steps.title: Hydrogenate phenyl naphthol to phenyl tetralin
steps.instruction: Hydrogenate the obtained trimethoxy phenyl naphthol (2a‑f) under suitable hydrogenation conditions to afford phenyl tetralin derivatives (compounds 3a‑f).

steps.title: Oxidize phenyl tetralin to substituted phenyl tetralone
steps.instruction: Oxidize the trimethoxy phenyl tetralin (4a‑f) using an appropriate oxidizing agent to generate the substituted phenyl tetralone series.

steps.title: Confirm structures by analytical methods
steps.instruction: Verify the structures of all synthesized compounds by spectral (e.g., NMR, IR, MS) and elemental analysis data.

steps.title: Screen compounds for biological activity
steps.instruction: Test the synthesized compounds for antidiabetic activity; note that compound 4d shows excellent activity, 4b and 4c show considerable activity, and 4a shows least activity. Additionally, evaluate antibacterial and antifungal activity of 4d against standard strains compared with chloramphenicol and nystatin.
